device.title: Add LED wall
device.description: Connect a NovaStar player in your local network (e.g. T series, Taurus). You need the same login you use in ViPlex Express.

data_description.host: The IP address of the LED controller in your network, e.g. 192.168.1.50. You can find it in your router or in ViPlex Express.
data_description.sn: Printed on the label of the controller and shown in ViPlex Express.
data_description.password: The password you use to log in to the controller in ViPlex Express. Note: after 3 wrong attempts the controller blocks logins for 60 seconds.
data_description.port: Only change this if you know what you are doing. Default: 16674.

cloud.title: Connect VNNOX cloud account
cloud.description:
Optional. With a cloud account Home Assistant also shows whether your walls are online in VNNOX. One account is enough for all walls.

**Where do I get the values?**
1. Open the NovaCloud Open Platform: Europe: {portal_eu} · USA: {portal_us}
2. Click “Log In” (top right) and sign in with your VNNOX account.
3. Open the “Authentication” tab and copy the three values below.

Important: the “VNNOX authentication information” (server address, authentication username/password) used to bind a player does **not** work here.

data_description.cloud_domain: Shown in the portal, e.g. open-eu.vnnox.com for Europe.
data_description.app_secret: Shown in the portal under “Authentication”. Keep it secret.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: Please confirm the login again. Possible reasons: the password was changed, or the security certificate of the controller has changed (e.g. after a factory reset or firmware update). If you did not change anything, check your network first – a changed certificate can also mean that someone is intercepting the connection.

data_description.host: The IP address of the LED controller in your network, e.g. 192.168.1.50. You can find it in your router or in ViPlex Express.
data_description.cloud_domain: Shown in the portal, e.g. open-eu.vnnox.com for Europe.

error.cannot_connect: The controller cannot be reached. Check the IP address and that it is switched on and in the same network.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check serial number, username and password. After 3 wrong attempts the controller blocks logins for 60 seconds.
error.not_supported: This controller's firmware does not support the interface used by this integration.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Details are in the Home Assistant log.
error.cloud_auth: VNNOX rejected the credentials. Check AppKey, AppSecret and especially the domain (e.g. open-eu… instead of open-us…).
error.cloud_connect: The VNNOX cloud cannot be reached. Check the domain.

abort.already_configured: This device or account is already set up.

init.title: Settings
init.description:
Tip: whether brightness and volume are stored permanently is set directly on the device with the switch “Store values permanently” (under Controls).
• On: the wall keeps the value after a restart or power cut.
• Off: the value only applies until the next restart. This protects the controller's memory if an automation changes the brightness very often (e.g. every minute).

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant reads the current values. Default: 30.
data_description.screenshot_interval: How often a new picture of the screen is taken. 0 = only when you press “Refresh screenshot”. Default: 60.

abort.no_options: The cloud account has no options.
